svg.text: The ring around the plaza, seen from above (lobby L4, claim on)
From the real WorldArt, WorldVisuals, LobbyConfig and PlotBuilding. Dashed: each lot (82.6 x 86.6).
Grey: the Floor. Thin: the Garage (stage 1); thick: Big Corporate (stage 5). Red: the door. Up is +Z.
